events.body:
## Bug

`website/views/queue.py:105` builds `tweet_url = f"{base_url}?{urlencode(params)}"`, but `urlencode` is never imported in the module. As soon as this line runs (during queue launch / tweet-link construction) it raises `NameError: name 'urlencode' is not defined`.

## Repro

Trigger the queue path that reaches line 105 (launching a queue item that builds the tweet share URL) → NameError.

## Suggested fix

    from urllib.parse import urlencode

Found by static analysis (ruff F821); no star-import masks the name. AI model used in analysis: Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code).
